fullContent:
Chandanosiradi Kashayam 
 Reference – Sahasra Yoga Kashaya prakarana 30 
 Introduction 
 Chandanosiradi Kashayam is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to treat the problems of pitta dosha. It is known to balance the pitta. Chandana is one of its main ingredients, which is known to contain medicinal properties like aromatic, cardiac-tonic, aphrodisiac, diuretic and antipyretic etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Chandana – Santalum album 
 Usheera – Vetiveria zizanioides 
 Mudga – Vigna radiate 
 Yava – Barley 
 Pippali – Piper longum 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Laja – Parched rice 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients in equal quantity. 
 Now put all the herbs in a pot and add water in it. 
 Now boil the water to make decoction. 
 Boil till the water is reduced to its one fourth level and the filter. 
 Your decoction is prepared. 
 
 Dose 
 
 12 to 24 ml, before meals, two times a day with equal amount of water. 
 For children – 3 to 5 ml with equal or double quantity of water, one to two times a day, before meals. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Bleeding disorders such as menorrhagia, nasal bleeding and ulcerative colitis. 
 Cold and cough 
 Fever 
 Polydipsia 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Precautions should be taken during pregnancy. 
 Take under medical prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
